ajay_csm: Heads-up: Acme onboarding flagged — last week's latency breach (p95 > 450ms target 300ms). Renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks. Need credit estimate and comms plan. Any numbers?

maria_cs: Thanks Ajay. I saw the alert. Can you paste the SLO window we're evaluating? 30d or billing month?

ajay_csm: Billing month. Rolling 30d shows 99.2% uptime; billing month 98.7%. They are on standard SLO (99.9 uptime, 300ms p95).

kevin_pm: Oof. Renewal risk rises if we can't offer clear remediation + credit fairness. Suggest: 1) immediate mitigation notes for account execs 2) draft credit calculation 3) timeline for fix. I can own comms.

sam_eng: Root cause: autoscaler misconfig with burst routing to lower-q models during index build. Fix deployed yesterday, rolling out. We have estimated extra latency window from 2026-03-10 02:10 UTC to 2026-03-15 14:40 UTC.

ajay_csm: Can ops-bot pull exact error windows + token usage for that period?

ops-bot: ops-bot: Ran query -> downtime-equivalent: 10800s (3h), weighted by request count -> effective impacted tokens: 2.4M. Raw logs: https://redwood.tld/logs/ingest/ACME-1234

maria_cs: Quick calc proposal: credits = floor(impacted_tokens / 1e6) * $500 + SLA prorate? Example: 2.4M -> $1000 baseline. Thoughts?

kevin_pm: We price per-token; but customer on committed plan. Ask finance: what's minimum credit for this tier? @sara_fin?

ajay_csm: I'll escalate. Meanwhile, Kevin can you draft the email with: apology, summary, fix, credit statement, next steps. Keep numbers non-technical.

kevin_pm: On it. Draft ETA EOD. Will propose $1k credit + 1 month of elevated monitoring (no charge).

maria_cs: :thumbsup: Sounds reasonable. Schedule a pre-send review with AE.

sam_eng: Posting a snippet for the postmortem: ```impact_window=2026-03-10T02:10Z..2026-03-15T14:40Z root_cause=autoscale-policy-misconfig fix=policy-rollforward-1.2```

ajay_csm: Thanks. I'll compile into a one-pager for the CSM handoff. Last q — do we annotate the SLO dashboard for Acme with the breach and credit calc?

maria_cs: Yes — do that after finance confirms. Tagging thread: #acct-Acme.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-20260315-ACME-LAT-009. Link: https://redwood.tld/inc/INC-20260315-ACME-LAT-009

kevin_pm: Draft ready: https://redwood.tld/drafts/acme-credit-email — sharing for review.

ajay_csm: Great work folks. Will update AE and loop back.
